items.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Driver front airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Shift cable can detach (car may roll away) (recall)
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Brake pedal bracket can break (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace brake pedal bracket
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can come loose and leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump and fuel pipe
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Rear defogger antenna module can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Sunroof switch can be bumped and close the roof (recall)
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Front seat may shift in a crash from weak weld (recall)
items.job: Inspect seat weld and replace lower seat track if needed
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Front lap belt pretensioners may not hold (recall)
items.job: Replace both front lap belt pretensioners
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: Brake lights flash and cruise control drops out (recall)
items.note: Free at a Cadillac dealer under the recall.

items.t: CUE touchscreen freezes, cracks or stops responding to touch
items.note: Aftermarket touch panels sit at the low end; one owner paid about $1,065 for a dealer screen replacement.

items.t: Eight-speed automatic shudders or shifts harshly
items.job: Transmission fluid exchange with revised fluid (GM bulletin 18-NA-355)
items.note: If the flush doesn't cure the shudder, a torque converter replacement costs much more.

items.t: Six-speed automatic shifts harshly or the torque converter fails
items.note: A leaking cooler line is a much cheaper repair; valve body work falls in between.

items.t: Rear differential and axle seals leak
items.job: Replace rear axle shaft or pinion seal and refill differential
items.note: RepairPal lists axle seal replacement at about $527-$738. A worn-out differential costs far more.

items.t: Turbo loses boost or fails on the 2.0T
items.note: RepairPal lists turbo replacement at about $1,624-$2,512. A cracked intake pipe is far cheaper.

items.t: Oil leak from the front timing cover on the V6
items.job: Remove and reseal engine front cover

items.t: Engine vibration and rough idle from worn engine mounts
Knocking from the steering shaft when turning
Front suspension clunks over bumps
items.job: Replace front lower control arm (one side)
items.note: Add an alignment, about $100-$150.

items.t: Radiator or cooling fan failure causes overheating
items.note: A cooling fan or hose costs less.

items.t: Airbag light from passenger seat sensor
A/C smells musty
items.job: Clean A/C evaporator and replace cabin filter

items.t: One side blows the wrong temperature
items.note: If the door itself is broken, dash removal can push labor to 8 hours or more.

items.t: Check engine light from evaporative vent valve
Tire pressure sensors fail
items.note: RepairPal lists TPMS light diagnosis at about $122-$179.

items.t: Engine stalls at stops or loses power
items.job: Diagnose stalling (scan, battery and connection tests)
items.note: Final cost depends on what the diagnosis finds.
